new.intent: Build independently evaluated exemption plans for current assets using only the exemption regimes made available by the current solved choice-of-law step.

plans.description: Per-asset records of independently applicable literal citations and claim values capped by asset value and the current statutory limit.

new.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    assets = inputs["asset_descriptions"]
    values = inputs["asset_values"]
    kinds = inputs["asset_kinds"]
    allowed = inputs["available_regimes"]
    citations = inputs["rule_citations"]
    caps = inputs["rule_caps"]
    multipliers = inputs["rule_multipliers"]
    rule_kinds = inputs["rule_asset_kinds"]
    rule_regimes = inputs["rule_regimes"]
    plans = []
    for i in range(len(assets)):
        claims = []
        for j in range(len(citations)):
            regime_allowed = rule_regimes[j] in allowed
            kind_matches = rule_kinds[j] == "any" or rule_kinds[j] == kinds[i]
            if regime_allowed and kind_matches:
                effective_cap = caps[j] * multipliers[j]
                claim_value = values[i]
                if caps[j] >= 0:
                    claim_value = min(values[i], effective_cap)
                claims = claims + [{"citation": citations[j], "claim_value": claim_value}]
        plans = plans + [{"asset": assets[i], "claims": claims}]
    return {"plans": plans}
